events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare untracked mirror files against the versions already on the remote
events.input: $ git ls-files --others --exclude-standard > /tmp/untracked.txt; wc -l < /tmp/untracked.txt; same=0; diff=0; absent=0; : > /tmp/coll_same.txt; : > /tmp/coll_diff.txt; while IFS= read -r f; do o=$(git rev-parse -q --verify "origin/main:$f" 2>/dev/null) || { absent=$((absent+1)); continue; }; h=$(git hash-object "$f"); if [ "$o" = "$h" ]; then same=$((same+1)); echo "$f" >> /tmp/coll_same.txt; else diff=$((diff+1)); echo "$f" >> /tmp/coll_diff.txt; fi; done < /tmp/untracked.txt; echo "same=$same diff=$diff absent=$absent"; head -5 /tmp/coll_diff.txt; grep -v -f /tmp/coll_same.txt /tmp/untracked.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Remove the five byte-identical untracked copies, then rebase onto the remote
events.input: $ cat /tmp/coll_same.txt; while IFS= read -r f; do rm -- "$f"; done < /tmp/coll_same.txt; git pull --rebase --autostash -q 2>&1 | tail -8; git status -sb | head -3; ls .git/rebase-merge 2>/dev/null | head -2; git stash list | head
